exposure: intramuscular injection of Diprofos (betamethasone dipropionate 5 mg/ ml and betamethasone sodium phosphate 2 mg/ml vial) once plus intravenous hydration
cohort: The study included fifty pregnant patients admitted to Al-Shatby Maternity University Hospital with hyperemesis gravidarum.
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in blood chloride levels between the group receiving long-acting corticosteroids plus intravenous hydration and the group receiving intravenous hydration alone, both before and after treatment.
